name: Tokyo Yamanote Boys Sweet Jelly Beans Disc

A Tokyo Yamanote Boys All Star Disc.
The story spans 3 days from the start of the confession tournament.
Experience a different story from what has been written so far.
translation: 《东京山手男孩》全明星碟。故事从告白大赛开始，跨越3天。体验与此前作品不同的故事。
